import os, collections
workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace')
progdir=workspace/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)\n    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    marks = [v for v in counts if v != background]\n    marker = marks[0] if marks else background\n    return [[marker if v == background else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]\n'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
